stem.text: Two students were discussing the involvement of DNA and RNA in transcription and translation.

items: Student 2 gave further information, which was sometimes correct.

rows:
A length of mRNA is 747 nucleotides
long, including stop and start codons.

This mRNA can produce a polypeptide
that is 249 amino acids long.

Adjacent mRNA codons of AAU
and CUG bind to complementary
tRNA anticodons.

There is a total of 14 hydrogen bonds
formed between these two codons and
their anticodons.

RNA polymerase catalyses the formation
of the mRNA from the template strand
of DNA.

During translation, an RNA adenine
nucleotide will pair with a DNA thymine
nucleotide.

A DNA adenine nucleotide is structurally
different to an RNA adenine nucleotide.

The difference is in the hexose sugars;
DNA is deoxyribose and RNA is ribose.

stem.text: Which further information, given by student 2, is correct?
